Committee: Boards, Agencies and Commissions
Sponsor: Sanderford
Analyst: Bryan Young
Date: 02/17/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 49 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Alabama Onsite Wastewater Board until October 1, 2023 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Howard Sanderford, Chair
Boards, Agencies and Commissions

Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
Sponsor: Sanderford
Analyst: Bryan Young
Date: 02/25/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 49 as passed the House of Representatives provides for the continuance of the Alabama Onsite Wastewater Board until October 1, 2023 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Steve Livingston, Chairperson
Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
